svg.aria-label: Three capabilities held at once make an exfiltration path: access to private data, processing of untrusted content, and the ability to send something outward. Removing any one of the three breaks the path.
svg.text: ALL THREE AT ONCE IS THE VULNERABILITY

g.text: Two of the three is a design. Three is an incident waiting for somebody to notice.
The defence is removing a capability for that session, not detecting the attack:
published filters were bypassed at over 90% by adaptive attackers, and 100% by people.
